project.title: Native existing-password cryptography
project.goal: Issue and verify source-compatible native password hashes without Node/Bun
project.scope: R04/R41 cryptography only; no login/account/session/DB mutation or writer admission

boundary.responsibility: Bounded password normalization, scrypt and OS entropy
boundary.rationale: Native identity must no longer depend on Node password crypto

scenario.when: Compare native and installed framework cryptography
scenario.then: Independent and actual framework hashes verify bidirectionally with native issuance

action.password_crypto.description: Native canonical scrypt password issuance and verification

errors.refused: invalid_credentials for wrong/missing/malformed/oversize credentials; auth_crypto_unavailable for native entropy/KDF configuration failure

preconditions: Trusted synchronous caller schedules bounded work; no DB/session/HTTP authority implied
postconditions: Canonical source-compatible hash or opaque refusal; no secret diagnostics or external mutations

authorization.rationale: Password proof is not account/MFA/session authority; fixed bounded crypto must retain secret diagnostics and runtime concurrency boundaries

action.password_crypto.behavior: Bounded Unicode17 NFKC then fixed scrypt salt-string scheme; OS-random issuance, fixed errors and dummy verification
